propositions: Residual live prose in three files must be migrated from Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria terminology and verified by allowlist.
A repository guard must scan for deprecated Success Criteria vocabulary case-insensitively across most of the codebase while excluding archives, experiments, vendor bundles, and cache directories.
Bare tokens SC or SCs must be matched only within specific scoped paths (reviewers, guides, routing configs, generated docs) and fail if found elsewhere.
A count-pinned plain-text allowlist with validation of field integrity, path presence, and count stability must be wired into the root Makefile lint target to prevent silent reintroduction.

Permanent deliberate carve-outs (four semantic sites owned by epic, T2 experiment language, Jira fixtures, migration test probes, and historical citations) must be represented in the allowlist at their exact current counts.
Four O-RAN-SC sites and the minified editor.js must remain byte-identical and outside the bare-token scan scope.
